name: Fashion Empire
description: Stitch a premium apparel empire from the ground up. Cotton fields, denim mills, and boutique shelves — designer jeans pay a brand premium, but only the High-income bracket will reach for $120 trousers. Middle-class shoppers balk over $150.

goals.description: Operate at least 2 farms — cotton is the foundation of the chain.
Operate at least 2 factories — weave denim and cut jeans in-house.
Put designer_jeans on a shelf — the brand isn't real until a High-income customer can buy it.
Reach 30% share of designer_jeans in Metropolis — where the High-income demographic clusters.
Earn $12M in cumulative net income — premium margins should carry the business.
